v1.description: Ask for data that already exists, and have it released. Say what the study is for, choose the fields it needs from the registry, and a data steward decides.

about.label: About the study
about.description: What you are asking, and why.

question.text: What question is the study trying to answer?

period.text: Which years should the data cover?

data.label: Which data do you need?
data.description: Choose the fields your analysis needs, and no more. Your choice stays tied to the registry version you chose from, so a later version cannot change it.

approval.label: Data access approval
approval.description: A data steward decides whether the data is released.
